why_this_document_exists: The gates passed on every branch that produced the integrated tree and fail on the tree itself. That is not a contradiction. Each cohort's gate ran over a tree holding only that cohort's files, and a whole-tree property is only testable once the tree is whole. GENUINE and FALSE_POSITIVE are judgements, so they live in a document a reader can argue with rather than inside the prober where they would be invisible.

observation_pin.why_pinned: The counts below are observations of one tree at one commit, not properties of the repository. They are recorded at an immutable pin so a reader can reproduce them; nothing asserts that a later recomputation still matches, because it should not -- the point of routing these findings is that they get fixed.

ci_surface_population.note: The CI-surface population is triaged here rather than left to the live gate, because the fix removed all of it: after the narrowing there is nothing left for the router to route. A verdict that leaves no trace in the tool's output is exactly the kind that needs writing down.

measured_at.hermeticity_accounting: 17 + 32 + 68 = 117. Every original finding is accounted for; none was dropped without a named reason.
measured_at.ci_surface_count_discrepancy_is_itself_a: The two counts differ because WARM_BYTECODE_CACHE fired once per __pycache__ file present, and how many are present depends on how many modules have been imported since checkout. A gate whose finding count measures how much of the suite has run measures nothing about the tree. That is why the rule was narrowed rather than the number reconciled.

sys_path_verdict.question: Is sys.path.insert a portability defect in this repository, or an accepted pattern?
sys_path_verdict.verdict: ACCEPTED_PATTERN. Downgraded from SYS_PATH_MUTATION to the advisory class SYS_PATH_ANCHORED when the argument derives from __file__.
sys_path_verdict.population: 68 findings across 66 files, owned by a1, a4, a5, a6, a7, a8 and a10.
reasoning: There is no installable package here. No pyproject, no setup.py, no __init__.py anywhere in workstreams/po03, and the engineering standard forbids third-party packages. So there is no import mechanism that a cohort declined to use.

The suite runs under python3 -I, which implies -P. That is the constraint I falsified during a3-u08: a script gets no script directory on sys.path, so a test cannot import a module beside it. Exactly two mechanisms remain -- mutate sys.path, or load by location with importlib.util.spec_from_file_location. Flagging one of two available mechanisms as a defect is not a portability judgement, it is a style preference wearing a gate's clothing.

The failure mode the rule was written for is an import path that a clean clone might not have: an absolute directory, a vendored sibling, a path read from the environment. Every one of the 68 derives its argument from __file__, transitively through roots such as PO03 = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]. A directory computed from __file__ is inside the clone by construction. The clean clone always has it, which is the whole property the rule exists to protect. I verified all 68 rather than sampling.

Routing 68 no-op fixes would have cost more than the gate is worth. Nineteen cohorts editing nineteen files to change nothing observable is how a gate loses its authority -- not because it was ignored, but because obeying it taught everyone that obeying it accomplishes nothing.
sys_path_verdict.what_is_not_dismissed: sys.path is process-global, so a position-0 insert can shadow a standard-library module of the same name, and it changes import resolution for every later test in the same discover run. That is real, and it is an ordering and shadowing hazard rather than a portability one. It stays reported as SYS_PATH_ANCHORED, which does not fail the gate, so the hazard is visible without being mistaken for the defect it is not.
sys_path_verdict.how_this_could_be_wrong: If a cohort ever inserts a directory computed from __file__ that is itself gitignored or generated, the argument is anchored and the directory still absent from a clean clone. The anchoring test would pass and the finding would be downgraded wrongly. Nothing in the tree does this today; the exposure is stated rather than guarded because guarding it means resolving the path at scan time, and a static prober that touches the filesystem to decide is no longer static.
sys_path_verdict.recall_is_unaffected: My planted fixture inserts the bare literal "vendor", which is unanchored, so SYS_PATH_MUTATION still fires at full severity on the case the rule was built for.

residual_imprecision.note: Four of the 17 reportable findings are false positives I chose not to suppress, because every mechanism I could find for suppressing them was a value allowlist rather than a structural rule. They are named here so the number is known rather than discovered: boundary_run.py:34 ENV_READ, and successor.py:204 and :207 ABS_PATH_LITERAL. Naming a known false positive is what keeps a gate credible; hiding one behind a forgiven-value list is what ends it.

what_i_did_not_do: No file outside workstreams/po03/runtime/, workstreams/po03/control/units/a3/, workstreams/po03/tests/test_a3_*, the two po03- workflows I own and receipts/po03/2026-08-22/ci-clean-clone.json was changed. Every genuine finding in another cohort's file is routed, not fixed.

COMPARISON_OPERAND.justification: The literal is a pattern matched against or split on, not a location opened.

ASSERTION_OPERAND.justification: The literal is the expected value of the thing under test.

REGEX_PATTERN.justification: The literal is a regular expression, so its leading slash is a character and not a root.

DIFF_PAYLOAD.justification: The literal is a unified diff. A patch quoting a defective line in order to remove it is the cure, not the disease.

JSON_POINTER.justification: An RFC 6902 operation addresses a document, not a filesystem.

FSTRING_FRAGMENT.justification: A fragment following an interpolation cannot be absolute however it begins.

PATTERN_TABLE.justification: A module-level table used only for comparison is a detector's data, not its paths.

TEST_FIXTURE.justification: A literal in a test module that reaches no filesystem sink is a value under test.
